taxonomy.label: Permanent free
taxonomy.definition: Access that does not expire, within published recurring rate limits. No credits to burn down.

taxonomy.label: Renewable quota
taxonomy.definition: Free access subject to recurring limits (rate limits and/or daily allowances) that reset. Renewable, not one-time.

taxonomy.label: Aggregator free
taxonomy.definition: Free model routes offered by an aggregator platform, not by the model developer directly.

taxonomy.label: Trial / credits
taxonomy.definition: Time-bound or credit-bound trial access. Ends when the trial window or promotional credits are exhausted.

taxonomy.label: Community free
taxonomy.definition: Community- or platform-sponsored free access governed by the hosting platform.

taxonomy.label: Requires card
taxonomy.definition: Free only behind a payment method on file (e.g. trial auto-renewal).

coverage.note: Fields are present only where verified. Geographic restrictions and local/self-hosted options are not part of this dataset.

providers.name: Google AI Studio
providers.description: Google's official AI studio offering Gemini 2.0 Flash, Gemini 2.5 Flash, and Gemma 2 models with generous free quotas.

providers.name: Groq
providers.description: Ultra-low latency inference via custom LPU chips. Fastest free tier at 330+ tok/s on Llama 3.3 70B.

providers.name: SambaNova Systems
providers.description: Reconfigurable dataflow unit (RDU) inference cloud. Sub-second latency on SN40L RDUs with daily free quota.

providers.name: Cerebras
providers.description: Wafer-scale AI inference on custom CS-3 systems. Fastest free tier at 2,100+ tok/s on Llama 3.3 70B.

providers.name: NVIDIA NIM
providers.description: NVIDIA inference microservices with 1,000 free promotional API credits. Enterprise-grade GPU-accelerated inference.

providers.name: Mistral AI
providers.description: European open-source LLM platform with MoE architecture. Free tier requires phone verification.

providers.name: Cloudflare Workers AI

providers.name: Hugging Face

providers.rateLimits: Developer trial quota; varies by model
providers.description: Free AI model gateway routing to frontier models including Qwen 2.5 Coder, DeepSeek Coder, and MiMo V2.5 with zero-cost access.

providers.name: Chutes.ai
providers.description: Community-hosted inference with free tiers. Fast deployment for open-source LLMs with competitive rates.

providers.name: ModelScope
providers.description: Chinese AI model hub with free inference endpoints for text, code, and vision models.

providers.name: OVHcloud AI Endpoints
providers.description: European sovereign AI endpoints with free tier. GDPR-compliant inference on OVHcloud infrastructure.
